Name: High Press
Description: Your players charge the ball carrier faster.
Notes: tune_press_speed adds 12 to the press_speed row of Tuning.csv. Any Tuning row works this way.

Name: Swarm
Description: One more player comes across from another quarter to help press.

Name: Wide Play
Description: Your players break further off their markers to show for a pass.

Name: Relentless
Description: Everyone runs at a loose ball harder.
Notes: Needs a Parent AND three wins. Both must be true.

Name: Brewing Basics
Description: The Pub can pour a Fire Brew.
Notes: Unlocks a brew by name. Brews.csv in step 4 will read this.

Name: Water Craft
Description: The Pub can pour a Water Brew.

Name: Steady Pour
Description: Your defenders stand off a little and read the play instead of diving in.

Name: Master Brewer
Description: A brew can be made permanent, and removed again later.
Notes: Needs five brews drunk. brews_drunk is filled by Stats.csv already.

Name: Marsh Legs
Description: Every player starts an Adventure run with 2 more stamina.
Notes: WORKED EXAMPLE - A TALENT THAT READS ADVENTURE. cleared_marshlands is written by beating the Marsh King. tune_ in front of any Tuning.csv key edits that number.

Name: Iron Shod
Description: Every won tier takes at least 2 off, not 1.
Notes: Gated on the Forge recipe above - so the chain is: Adventure -> bog iron -> the Forge -> this talent.

Name: Deep Pockets
Description: Fleeing costs you nothing you were not going to lose anyway.
Notes: Costs coins to TAKE rather than to unlock - Cost 1 is the talent point, Requires is the money.
